scripts.test:run: yarn test:shoe-images && yarn workspace web test:run && yarn test:convex
scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently "yarn workspace web dev" "yarn workspace backend-api dev"
scripts.dev:ngrok: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently "yarn workspace web dev" "yarn workspace backend-api dev:ngrok"
scripts.dev:convex: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently "yarn workspace web dev" "yarn workspace backend-api dev" "npx convex dev"
scripts.dev:backend: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently "yarn workspace backend-api dev" "npx convex dev"
scripts.dev:all: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently "yarn workspace web dev" "yarn workspace backend-api dev:ngrok" "npx convex dev"
scripts.dev:all:terminals: dotenv -e .env -- start start-dev.bat && start start-backend.bat && start start-convex.bat
scripts.dev:mac: dotenv -e .env -- osascript -e 'tell application "Terminal" to do script "cd packages/web && yarn dev"' && osascript -e 'tell application "Terminal" to do script "cd packages/backend-api && yarn dev"'
scripts.dev:ngrok:mac: dotenv -e .env -- osascript -e 'tell application "Terminal" to do script "cd packages/web && yarn dev"' && osascript -e 'tell application "Terminal" to do script "cd packages/backend-api && yarn dev:ngrok"'
scripts.dev:all:mac: dotenv -e .env -- osascript -e 'tell application "Terminal" to do script "cd packages/web && yarn dev"' && osascript -e 'tell application "Terminal" to do script "cd packages/backend-api && yarn dev:ngrok"' && osascript -e 'tell application "Terminal" to do script "npx convex dev"'
